title: Scope and safeguards for site intelligence (safety, segmentation, drywall readiness)
question: Which of safety monitoring, asset segmentation and drywall readiness are on the roadmap? For safety, which protective equipment is detected, how simultaneous hazards are prioritised, what false-positive rate is acceptable, and is facial recognition acceptable given privacy? For drywall, what criteria make an area ready?
context: All four requirements in PROG-FEAT-13 are PRD only. Safety assumes live video feeds that Track3D doesn't ingest today, and the drywall PRD does not define readiness.
